title: A real PDF file whose injected text is inside a drawn table cell
note: corpus/pdf/table_cell_injection.pdf is an actual PDF - uncompressed content stream, table rules drawn with `re`, text placed cell by cell with `Tj`. The test extracts the text operators and runs the same screen over the result, so the corpus is not entirely made of strings we typed. What it does NOT claim is a test of Docling or Textract: the format router is another domain's, and layers 2 to 6 all operate on extracted text.
